metadata.name: hookwars_war
metadata.description: Hookwars war chests: sieges, counter-strikes, razes, bounties, loot rolls, quests and seasons, every spend permissionless, capped and paid from a token's own war chest (docs/spec/05-war.md).

instructions.name: accrue_treaty_time
docs: Adds the season time treaties held to the score's counter.

instructions.name: apply_config
docs: Anyone applies a proposed config change after its `eta`.

instructions.name: cancel_pending
docs: The admin cancels a pending config change, season or loot table before it applies.

accounts.name: target
docs: a config change.

instructions.name: cancel_roll
docs: The owner closes an expired roll (no ticket refund).

instructions.name: claim_boss_share
docs: Pays a source token's chest its share of the sealed boss pool.

instructions.name: claim_bounty
docs: A holder turns raid points into SOL from the chest.

instructions.name: claim_quest
docs: Claims a quest's loot ticket, once per period.

instructions.name: close_quest_mark
docs: Returns a quest mark's rent once its season is finalized.

instructions.name: coalition_raze
docs: Sells the shared chest's captured rival tokens back, slowly.

instructions.name: coalition_siege
docs: The shared chest's siege of a non-member rival.

accounts.name: member_mint
docs: The member whose War orders and raid ledger make the siege due.

instructions.name: contribute
docs: Moves part of a member's chest into the coalition's shared chest.

instructions.name: counter_strike
docs: After a fall, the chest buys back its own token and burns it.

instructions.name: dissolve_coalition
docs: Returns the shared chest to the members pro rata after the term.

instructions.name: finalize_season
docs: Finalizes a season after its challenge window.

instructions.name: form_coalition
docs: Forms coalition `id` of the tokens whose Coalition items name it.

instructions.name: init_boss_pool
docs: The admin names season `season`'s boss token and opens its pool.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates the config, once, by this program's upgrade authority.

accounts.name: authority
docs: This program's upgrade authority, paying the rent.

instructions.name: init_war
docs: A token's war state, chest and treaty inbox.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The mint's launch: a war chest buys back on the launch pool.

instructions.name: join_coalition
docs: A token whose Coalition item names the id joins before the first contribution (review 3).

instructions.name: open_rivalry
docs: Opens a rivalry from a Rivalry item: ring-fences its budget in the chest.

instructions.name: open_season
docs: Opens the next season.

accounts.name: previous
docs: The running season, when there is one (it must be finalized).

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: The admin proposes a config change, applied after `admin_timelock_secs`.

instructions.name: propose_loot_table
docs: The admin proposes a season's loot table, behind the timelock.

instructions.name: propose_season
docs: The admin proposes a season (weights and dates), behind the timelock.

instructions.name: raze
docs: Sells captured rival tokens back into the rival's pool, slowly.

instructions.name: record_funding
docs: Counts what reached the chest since the last write.

accounts.name: config
docs: Security review 2, M-B: the season the funding counts for.

instructions.name: return_captured
docs: Peace: captured rival tokens to the rival's chest, under a treaty both equip.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: Reads the randomness and asks the armory to mint the item.

accounts.name: revealer
docs: Pays the item's rent; anyone.

instructions.name: roll
docs: Spends a loot ticket and asks the randomness adapter.

instructions.name: seal_boss_pool
docs: Seals the boss pool from the boss's raid ledger after the season's end.

instructions.name: settle_rivalry
docs: Settles a rivalry: score only, nothing moves between chests.

instructions.name: share_treaty_inflow
docs: Streams what treaties paid this token to its holders through the kit.

instructions.name: siege
docs: The chest spot-buys a rival that has been raided into this token enough.

accounts.name: rival_war_state
docs: a war state it is marked besieged; empty only while the rival has no war state.

instructions.name: split_protocol_fees
docs: Splits the prize vault between the last winner's chest and the treasury.

accounts.name: winner_season
docs: The last winner's season (its `prize_paid` accumulates).

accounts.name: boss_pool
docs: cranker cannot leave the boss share out). When a pool lives there, is effective and not
sealed, it takes `boss_share_bps`; otherwise nothing.

instructions.name: submit_candidate
docs: Submits a token as the season's leader, or challenges the leader.

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: the war state of this mint already exists

errors.name: MissingWarSlot
errors.msg: the mint has no War slot

errors.name: NoWarOrders
errors.msg: the War slot is empty, or the orders turn this action off

errors.name: WrongWarOrders
errors.msg: the item is not the War orders the mint's War slot names

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: an account the step needs was not passed

errors.name: NothingToDo
errors.msg: nothing to do

errors.name: ChestInsufficient
errors.msg: the chest cannot pay this

errors.name: SelfSiege
errors.msg: a token cannot besiege itself

errors.name: SiegeTargetHasRewards
errors.msg: the rival's kit has holder rewards on: a war chest cannot hold it

errors.name: OwnTokenHasRewards
errors.msg: this token's kit has holder rewards on: its chest cannot hold it

errors.name: SiegeNotDue
errors.msg: the siege is not due

errors.name: CapturedTableFull
errors.msg: the captured table is full

errors.name: CounterNotDue
errors.msg: the counter-strike is not due

errors.name: NoObservations
errors.msg: the observations do not cover the window

errors.name: RazeDisabled
errors.msg: the War orders do not allow razing

errors.name: RazeLimit
errors.msg: this window's raze allowance is used

errors.name: PeaceReturnsOff
errors.msg: the treaty does not return captured holdings

errors.name: NoTreaty
errors.msg: the treaty is not equipped by both tokens

errors.name: TouchMismatch
errors.msg: the touch did not change the holding as asked

errors.name: RandomnessNotReady
errors.msg: the randomness is not ready

errors.name: WrongRandomness
errors.msg: the randomness account is not this roll's

errors.name: RollNotExpired
errors.msg: the roll has not expired

errors.name: QuestAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: the quest was already claimed this period

errors.name: QuestConditionUnmet
errors.msg: the quest's condition is not met

errors.name: SeasonNotOpen
errors.msg: no season is open

errors.name: SeasonNotEnded
errors.msg: the season has not ended

errors.name: ChallengeClosed
errors.msg: the challenge window is closed

errors.name: NotHigherScore
errors.msg: the score is not higher than the leader's

errors.name: SeasonNotFinalized
errors.msg: the season is not finalized

errors.name: TimelockNotPassed
errors.msg: the timelock has not passed

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: only the admin may do this

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: only the program's upgrade authority may create the config

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: invalid parameters

errors.name: WrongForeignAccount
errors.msg: a foreign account does not decode as the spec's layout

errors.name: NoQuote
errors.msg: the pool gives no quote

errors.name: WrongLaunch
errors.msg: the launch is not this mint's

errors.name: WrongRaidSlot
errors.msg: the slot is not this program's Raid slot

errors.name: NothingPending
errors.msg: nothing is pending

errors.name: SeasonClosed
errors.msg: the season is already open or finalized

errors.name: LootTableNotReady
errors.msg: the season's loot table is missing or not yet in force

errors.name: InvalidLootEntry
errors.msg: a loot entry is outside its template

errors.name: NoTreatyTemplate
errors.msg: the treaty template is not configured

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: the account passed is not the one expected

errors.name: ItemNotEquipped
errors.msg: the token does not equip that item

errors.name: WrongItem
errors.msg: the item is not of the template this step reads

errors.name: BossPoolState
errors.msg: the boss pool is sealed or not yet sealable

errors.name: NoBossShare
errors.msg: this source has no share or has claimed it

errors.name: InvalidCoalition
errors.msg: the coalition's members are invalid

errors.name: CoalitionClosed
errors.msg: the coalition has ended or is dissolved

errors.name: CoalitionNotDone
errors.msg: the coalition has not ended yet, or still holds captured tokens

errors.name: ContributionLimit
errors.msg: the contribution is above the item's cap or inside its interval

errors.name: RivalryState
errors.msg: the rivalry is invalid, not live, or already open

types.name: BossPool
docs: `BossPool` at `["boss", season: u32 le]` (10 section 11.1): funded by `boss_share_bps` of the
prize split while its season runs, sealed from the boss token's `RaidLedger` after the season's
end, then paid out to the source tokens' war chests by `claim_boss_share`.

fields.name: boss_mint
docs: The season's boss token (named by the admin at `init_boss_pool`).

fields.name: funded
docs: Lamports paid in by `split_protocol_fees`.

fields.name: paid
docs: Lamports paid out by `claim_boss_share`.

fields.name: total_volume
docs: Sum of the sealed sources' volumes.

fields.name: to_share
docs: Lamports to share at the seal (`funded` then).

fields.name: effective_at
docs: Review 3 L-7: the pool takes no prize share before this (`init_boss_pool` time plus
`admin_timelock_secs`), so naming a boss gives notice like every other admin setter.

types.name: BossSource
docs: Pass 4b (10 section 11.1): one source's recorded raid volume into the boss, sealed.

types.name: Captured
docs: A rival holding a chest captured.

fields.name: cost
docs: Bridged SOL spent on it.

types.name: Coalition
docs: `Coalition` at `["coalition", id: u32 le]` (10 section 8): members' contributions into a shared
chest `["coalition-chest", id]`, spent only by `coalition_siege` and refilled by
`coalition_raze`, returned pro rata at `dissolve_coalition`.

fields.name: funded_total
docs: Solvency totals of the shared chest, as `WarState`'s.

types.name: CoalitionJoined
docs: Review 3 L-3: a token whose Coalition item names the id joined before the first contribution.

types.name: ConfigArgs
docs: Arguments of `init_config` and `propose_config`.

types.name: ConfigChange
docs: What a config change proposes (05 section 11).

types.name: Launch
docs: A launch at `["launch", mint]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who launched it.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool on the DEX.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The quote mint.

fields.name: status
docs: `STATUS_CURVE` or `STATUS_GRADUATED`.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: LP fee of the pool.

fields.name: sniper_window_secs
docs: Sniper window.

fields.name: sniper_start_bps
docs: LP fee at the start of the window.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote reserve at opening.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base reserve.

fields.name: graduation_quote
docs: Real quote reserve at which the launch graduates.

fields.name: curve_tokens
docs: Tokens on the curve.

fields.name: reserve_tokens
docs: Tokens reserved for graduation.

fields.name: reserve_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the token (the reserve, then nothing).

fields.name: quote_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the quote (creator fees).

fields.name: lp_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the pool's LP mint (locked for ever).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: Graduation time (0 until then).

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued
docs: Creator fees taken so far.

fields.name: creator_fees_claimed
docs: Creator fees claimed so far.

fields.name: graduation_topup
docs: Base added to the pool at graduation.

fields.name: graduation_burned
docs: Base burned at graduation.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, fixed at launch.

fields.name: modules
docs: The kit modules of `rules` (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: `PDA(["kit", mint], KIT_ID)`, derived whatever the modules (the pool hook's fixed key).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `holding(quote_mint, kit_config)`, derived whatever the modules: the kit's reward vault
when holder rewards are on, where holder fees go.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`, which signs the kit's `init` and
`graduate`; 0 without a kit.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: slot_launch
docs: Hookwars M3b: `constants::hookwars::SLOT_LAUNCH` when the launch was made with
`prepare_launch` and `create_prepared_launch` (its mint runs a slot table, its pool hook
forwards to pool items); 0 otherwise. Taken from `reserved`, so `Launch::LEN` is unchanged.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: LootEntry
docs: One template a roll may mint, with its weight and a range per field (05 section 8.3).

types.name: LootTable
docs: `LootTable` at `["loot", season: u32 le]`.

types.name: Mint
docs: A mint. Address: any signer at creation (a keypair, or a PDA of the creating program).

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals.

fields.name: supply
docs: Current supply.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Largest supply ever allowed; 0 means unlimited.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: May mint; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: freeze_authority
docs: May freeze and thaw holdings; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: hook_authority
docs: May change the hook; `None` locks the hook for ever.

fields.name: metadata_authority
docs: May change the metadata; `None` fixes it for ever.

fields.name: hook_program
docs: The hook program, if any.

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: Which callbacks run (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`).

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the creation.

fields.name: hook_signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", hook_program]`, this program's signer of every callback to the
hook (one per hook program, so a hook can tell its own callbacks from a signer another hook
passed on); 0 without a hook. Set with the hook.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

fields.name: slot_authority
docs: Hookwars: the armory's `["slots", mint]` PDA, which alone may change the slots and vote
locks; `None` when the table never changes.

fields.name: slot_count
docs: Hookwars: entries of `slots` in use (0: no slot table, the upstream single hook applies).

fields.name: slots
docs: Hookwars: the slot table, in call order; entries at `slot_count..` are zero.

types.name: ParamRange
docs: A parameter's range in a loot entry.

types.name: PendingCancelled
docs: What `cancel_pending` cancelled: 0 the config change, 1 a season, 2 a loot table.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: A proposed change of the config, applied by anyone after `eta` (05 section 11).

types.name: QuestMark
docs: `QuestMark` at `["quest", season: u32 le, mint, owner]` (05 section 9; for `Forge` the mint is
the default key).

types.name: RazeWaited
docs: Security review 1, M-3: a raze waited (the rival trades too far below its TWAP).

types.name: RivalryBudget
docs: Pass 4b (10 section 11.3, R36): a live rivalry's ring-fenced budget inside the token's own
chest. Only an accounting reservation: the lamports never leave the chest because of it.

fields.name: rival
docs: The rival mint (default: no rivalry).

fields.name: rival_chest
docs: The rival's chest (a counter-strike against its siege may spend the budget).

fields.name: item
docs: The Rivalry item that opened it.

fields.name: budget
docs: Lamports ring-fenced at `open_rivalry`.

fields.name: spent
docs: Of it, spent against the rival.

types.name: RivalrySettled
docs: `won`: this token's raid volume from the rival beat the rival's from it (score and badge only;
nothing moves between the chests, R36).

types.name: RollRequest
docs: `RollRequest` at `["roll", holding, nonce: u64 le]` (05 section 8.2).

fields.name: item
docs: The new item, as the armory derives it; default when the armory names it in its own event
(`LootMinted`).

types.name: ScoreWeights
docs: One `u64` weight per counter (05 section 10.2).

fields.name: rivalry_wins
docs: Pass 4b (10 section 11.3).

types.name: Season
docs: `Season` at `["season", number: u32 le]` (05 section 10.2).

fields.name: eta
docs: From the timelock.

fields.name: prize_paid
docs: Prize paid to this season's winner so far.

types.name: SeasonArgs
docs: Arguments of `propose_season`.

types.name: SeasonCounters
docs: A season's counters of one token: values only, never marked to market (05 section 2.4).

fields.name: funded
docs: Security review 2, M-B: what the chest received in this season (bridged SOL, from
`note_funding`). The score counts raid volume only up to `raid_volume_per_funded` times this.

fields.name: rivalry_wins
docs: Pass 4b (10 section 11.3): rivalries this token won in the season (`settle_rivalry`).

types.name: SliceArgs
docs: Arguments of `siege`, `counter_strike`, `raze` and `return_captured`: how many of the
remaining accounts are token slices the client resolved (in the order the step names).

types.name: Slot
docs: One slot of a mint (docs/spec/01-token-slots.md section 1.1).

fields.name: kind
docs: `bordrless_hook::slot_kind`.

fields.name: equip_rule
docs: `bordrless_hook::equip_rule` (stored, never acted on here).

fields.name: bounds
docs: Fixed bounds.

fields.name: data_offset
docs: First byte of this slot's range in `Holding.hook_data`.

fields.name: data_len
docs: Length of the range (item slots: including the epoch byte; 0 without data).

fields.name: item
docs: The equipped item (default when empty or Locked).

fields.name: program
docs: The program that runs (default when empty).

fields.name: flags
docs: Token callbacks and answers (`bordrless_hook::slot_flags`).

fields.name: pool_flags
docs: Pool slots only: the launchpad's pool flags (stored, never read here).

fields.name: equip_vault
docs: The only holding a cut of this slot may credit (default when the slot never cuts).

fields.name: signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", program]` under this program.

fields.name: launch_signer_bump
docs: Pool slots only: bump of the launchpad's `["hook-authority", program]`.

fields.name: data_epoch
docs: Tags this slot's data in every holding; changes on every equip; starts at 1.

fields.name: extra_count
docs: Extra accounts the item takes after its program and signer (fixed when equipped; the
Locked slot's when created). Hookwars M1: replaces the `slot_accounts` argument (M1 notes).

types.name: SlotBounds
docs: Bounds a slot keeps for life.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: Most an item in this slot may cut from one transfer, in bps of the amount.

fields.name: may_refuse
docs: Whether an item may refuse operations (declared; not enforceable at run time).

fields.name: may_write_data
docs: Whether an item may write this slot's hook-data range.

fields.name: may_answer_touch
docs: Whether an item may answer `touch`.

fields.name: may_burn
docs: Hookwars R21: Pool slots only: whether an item may burn part of a swap (through the
launchpad's pool-slot forwarding, M3b).

types.name: WarConfig
docs: `WarConfig` at `["war-config"]` (05 section 2.1).

fields.name: protocol_treasury
docs: Receives protocol fees after the season prize share.

fields.name: randomness_program
docs: The randomness adapter (D-4; section 8.2).

fields.name: treaty_template_id
docs: The armory template id of Treaty items (`return_captured`, `accrue_treaty_time`); `None`
until the admin names it. War orders are recognised by their kind, `War` (one template).

fields.name: current_season
docs: Season now running (0 before the first).

fields.name: last_winner
docs: Mint that won the last finalized season, and that season.

types.name: WarParams
docs: Every policy number of the war program (00 section 6, the parameters 05 uses). Set at
`init_config` and changed only through the timelock (`propose_config`, `apply_config`).

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS`: delay on every admin change (D-9).

fields.name: max_crank_bounty_bps
docs: `MAX_CRANK_BOUNTY_BPS`: ceiling on any war step's crank bounty (at most the companion's).

fields.name: siege_interval_secs
docs: `SIEGE_INTERVAL_SECS`: spacing of a chest's sieges; also how long a besieged token is
"under siege".

fields.name: siege_max_spend_bps
docs: `SIEGE_MAX_SPEND_BPS`: ceiling on a siege's spend, of the chest.

fields.name: siege_max_premium_bps
docs: `SIEGE_MAX_PREMIUM_BPS`: a siege waits while the rival trades above its TWAP by more.

fields.name: siege_slippage_bps
docs: `SIEGE_SLIPPAGE_BPS`: a siege or raze takes no less than the quote less the fees and this.

fields.name: siege_unit_lamports
docs: `SIEGE_UNIT_LAMPORTS`: the unit of the War orders' `siege_threshold`.

fields.name: counter_max_spend_bps
docs: `COUNTER_STRIKE_MAX_SPEND_BPS`: ceiling on a counter-strike's spend, of the chest.

fields.name: counter_min_interval_secs
docs: `COUNTER_STRIKE_MIN_INTERVAL_SECS`: floor on the War orders' counter-strike spacing.

fields.name: raze_max_bps_per_interval
docs: `RAZE_MAX_BPS_PER_INTERVAL`, `RAZE_INTERVAL_SECS`: how fast captured holdings may be sold.

fields.name: bounty_max_per_claim
docs: `BOUNTY_MAX_PER_CLAIM` (lamports).

fields.name: min_twap_secs
docs: `MIN_TWAP_SECS`: the shortest window any price read may use.

fields.name: raid_window_secs
docs: `RAID_WINDOW_SECS`: the raid ledger's window (the items program writes with the same).

fields.name: roll_expiry_secs
docs: `ROLL_EXPIRY_SECS`: an unfulfilled roll may be cancelled after this.

fields.name: quest_period_secs
docs: `QUEST_PERIOD_SECS`, `QUEST_RAID_POINTS`.

fields.name: season_secs
docs: `SEASON_SECS`, `CHALLENGE_SECS`.

fields.name: season_prize_share_bps
docs: `SEASON_PRIZE_SHARE_BPS`: of the prize vault, to the last winner's chest.

fields.name: point_unit_lamports
docs: `POINT_UNIT_LAMPORTS` (M3b): raid quote volume per raid point unit (the Raid item reads it).

fields.name: loot_min_raid_lamports
docs: `LOOT_MIN_RAID_LAMPORTS` (M3b): the smallest raid buy that earns a loot ticket.

fields.name: raze_max_discount_bps
docs: Security review 1, M-3: a raze waits while the rival trades below its TWAP by more than
this (basis points). To set.

fields.name: bounty_max_point_bps
docs: Security review 1, M-6: one raid point never pays more than this share of the quote volume
it stands for (`point_unit_lamports`), in basis points, whatever the War orders' rate. To set.

fields.name: raid_volume_per_funded
docs: Security review 2, M-B: raid volume a season score counts per lamport the chest received in
the season. Washed raid volume costs nothing but fees; real chest funding is real money, so
the score can only be bought at this price. 0 leaves raid volume out of the score. To set.

fields.name: boss_share_bps
docs: Pass 4b, `BOSS_SHARE_BPS` (10 section 11.1): of the prize vault's split, to the running
season's `BossPool` when `split_protocol_fees` is given one. To set.

fields.name: contribute_interval_secs
docs: Pass 4b, `CONTRIBUTE_INTERVAL_SECS` (10 section 8): spacing of one member's contributions
to its coalition's chest. To set.
